title: runs --reconcile in a checkout behind origin/main writes none over the landed run state of an item that has landed
goal: runs --reconcile writes none over a landed run state only when the item file is not done in this checkout and not done on the integration main either, so a checkout that has not pulled a landing leaves the landed key

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib as P
T = os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py"); COORD = os.path.abspath("_tools/coord.py")
d = P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); rem = d / "remote.git"
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", str(rem)], check=True)
r = d / "clone"
subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", str(rem), str(r)], check=True, capture_output=True)
g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(r), "-c", "user.name=x", "-c", "user.email=x@x", *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
(r / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items", "scratch_dir": "_cache/scratch", "worktree_dir": "wt", "land_push": ["git", "push", "origin", "HEAD:main"]}))
(r / ".gitignore").write_text("_cache/\nwt/\n")
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=str(d / "c.sqlite"), GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="x", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="x@x", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="x", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="x@x")
env.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
run = lambda *a: subprocess.run(list(a), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=120)
bl = lambda *a: run(sys.executable, T, "--root", str(r), *a)
g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "init")
iid = bl("new", "story", "--title", "A", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "x.txt").stdout.split()[2]
g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "items"); g("push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main")
p = r / "items" / (iid + ".json")
item = json.load(open(p)); item["status"] = "done"; item["evidence"] = {"commit": g("rev-parse", "HEAD"), "checks": []}
p.write_text(json.dumps(item, indent=2) + "\n"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "done"); g("push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main")
g("reset", "-q", "--hard", "HEAD~1"); g("fetch", "-q", "origin")
rev = (json.loads(run(sys.executable, COORD, "get", "run/" + iid).stdout) or {}).get("revision", 0)
assert run(sys.executable, COORD, "put", "run/" + iid, "--value=landed", "--revision", str(rev)).returncode == 0
bl("runs", iid, "--reconcile")
state = json.loads(run(sys.executable, COORD, "get", "run/" + iid).stdout).get("value")
print("run state after reconcile in a checkout behind origin/main:", state)
sys.exit(0 if state == "landed" else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-pww4aqis fresh-context review on 2026-11-09, and flagged by the worker of BG-gt4i6ec6 in its report as a stale-checkout risk. bl_runs.drift_of reads only the local item file for the landed to none arm; the on_main guard of BG-5tvbfivn covers only the done to landed direction. Premise reproduces on origin/main (repro prints none, exits 1). Fix direction: write none only when the item is not done on refs/remotes/<remote>/main either.
